sourceNameCrosswalk.reason: Official DNR calls the separate west approach CR519; state MGF labels the west connector Presque Isle Rd, without an explicit county-road number in its RDNAME field. These names align spatially to the DNR park 519 approach. This is map-source reconciliation, not live road inspection.

westApproach.name: MGF Presque Isle Rd
westApproach.southernCenterlineTerminus: Named MGF line begins near 46.5164N; this dataset does not validate an unbroken drive from downtown Wakefield or any other origin.
westApproach.northernCenterlineTerminus: Mapped south junction with S Boundary Rd at approximately 46.6956N. This does not establish a direct driveway to the Presque Isle DNR parking asset.

westernSouthBoundary.claim: The source-matched South Boundary segment west of the Pinkerton access point should not share the east-of-Pinkerton seasonal-closure flag solely because its road name is the same.
westernSouthBoundary.closurePolicy: DNR says its closed South Boundary portion starts at Headquarters Road and ends at Pinkerton Trailhead; the separate CR519 west-side access remains possible. Exact current gate position and travel-day conditions remain unverified.

evidenceLimitations: MGF is road centerlines, not live legal driving directions

Road dataset does not certify bridge load restrictions, plowing, temporary gates or turns
Never route across the seasonal South Boundary portion east of Pinkerton or restricted M-107
CR519 MGF southern line terminates north of Wakefield and has no certified origin-to-park routing
Final spur from South Boundary to the independently mapped DNR lot is not a signed/inspected drive route

parkingAsset.proof: DNR parking asset corroborated by separately named DNR recreation point; not a legal route to/from CR519
